video.title: AI欧腐《天降萌崽：我的黑豹小宝贝/Fate Brought Me My Cute Panther Cub》
video.desc:
又是这个本 依旧没完结的样子
Zachary dies saving a child and wakes in a world of shifters, with a frightened cub calling him father and a dangerously handsome panther calling him mate. Neither trusts him. Armed with modern know-how, he sets out to fill their bowls, warm their cave, and win their hearts. But as suspicion turns to desire, forgotten memories stir. Is he falling for another man's lover, or finding his way back to a love that was always his?
Zachary 为救一个孩子而死，一睁眼却来到了兽人世界——一只惊慌失措的小豹崽叫他爸爸，一头危险又英俊的黑豹叫他伴侣。而这两个，谁都不信任他。
凭着现代人的知识，他开始动手：填饱他们的肚子，暖好他们的山洞，一点点收服他们的心。可当猜忌渐渐化为渴望，被遗忘的记忆也开始苏醒。
他是在爱上别人的爱人，还是在一步步找回那份原本就属于他的爱？
